scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n FRONTEND,ADMIN -c auto "pnpm run dev:frontend" "pnpm run dev:admin"
scripts.build: concurrently -k -n FRONTEND,ADMIN -c auto "pnpm run build:frontend" "pnpm run build:admin"
scripts.lint: concurrently -k -n FRONTEND,ADMIN -c auto "pnpm run lint:frontend" "pnpm run lint:admin"
scripts.lint:fix: concurrently -k -n FRONTEND,ADMIN -c auto "pnpm --filter edit-markdown lint -- --fix" "pnpm --filter admin-frontend lint -- --fix"
scripts.format: concurrently -k -n FRONTEND,ADMIN -c auto "pnpm run format:frontend" "pnpm run format:admin"
scripts.format:write: concurrently -k -n FRONTEND,ADMIN -c auto "pnpm --filter edit-markdown format -- --write" "pnpm --filter admin-frontend format -- --write"
scripts.type-check: concurrently -k -n FRONTEND,ADMIN -c auto "pnpm run type-check:frontend" "pnpm run type-check:admin"
scripts.test: concurrently -k -n FRONTEND,ADMIN -c auto "pnpm run test:frontend" "pnpm run test:admin"
scripts.test:watch: concurrently -k -n FRONTEND,ADMIN -c auto "pnpm run test:watch:frontend" "pnpm run test:watch:admin"
scripts.test:cov: concurrently -k -n FRONTEND,ADMIN -c auto "pnpm run test:cov:frontend" "pnpm run test:cov:admin"
scripts.pre-commit:check: pnpm run lint:fix && pnpm run format:write && pnpm run type-check && pnpm run test
scripts.quality: pnpm run lint && pnpm run type-check && pnpm run test
scripts.quality:fix: pnpm run lint:fix && pnpm run format:write && pnpm run type-check
